content.short: Trenchverse is a Web3 indie game studio making casual on-chain games, with 20+ live titles.
content.description: Trenchverse is a Web3-first indie studio focused on making on-chain games fun, familiar and easy to pick up. It reports more than 20 live games, 2 million plays and 100,000 unique users, and publishes games such as ArcadeX as mini apps in World App.
content.meta: Trenchverse is an indie studio with 20+ casual on-chain games, published as World App mini apps.
